Earlier this week, you viewed a set of emotional pictures and rated how negative and positive each one was. Now let's see how many you can remember! In the box below, for each picture you remember, please describe it in as much detail as possible so that someone will be able to identify the picture you describe.

For example, instead of "bird," include descriptions like "yellow bird sitting on a tree branch."

Press the Enter key after each image description to save your response. Press Stop when you are done.
